namespaces.name: opencode
namespaces.description: Tools for managing OpenCode itself, such as working with sessions and worktrees, searching the available models, and reading MCP resources.

tools.name: opencode_session_rename
tools.description: Rename a session, or omit sessionID to rename the current session. Use a short, specific title that summarizes the work being done.

sessionID.description: Omit to rename the current session.

tools.name: opencode_session_move
tools.description: Move a session to another directory, or omit sessionID to move the current session. The current session moves at the next safe boundary; do not run destination-dependent tools in the same execute call.

sessionID.description: Omit to move the current session.

directory.description: Destination directory, relative to the target session's directory or absolute. Supports ~.

tools.name: opencode_worktree_create
tools.description: Create a named worktree. Returns its directory.

tools.name: opencode_worktree_remove
tools.description: Remove a worktree. The repository location selects configuration; directory identifies the worktree to remove.

directory.description: Absolute path of the worktree to remove.

force.description: Discard modified and untracked files. Only set this when the user has confirmed forced removal.

tools.name: opencode_models
tools.description: Search the models available to use. Use this to turn a model name the user mentions into an exact reference for a tool that takes a model. Check your own provider first.

query.description: Text to search for in model names and IDs.

provider.description: Provider ID or name to filter by. Try your own provider first.

type.description:
Which kind of model to list. Defaults to "chat".
"chat": a language model (LLM). Powers sessions, agents and subagents, and can call tools.
"image": generates or edits images from a prompt. It can't chat or call tools.

all.description: Include older versions of each model family. By default only the newest version is listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return. Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Number of models to skip, for paging through results.

released.description: Release date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds, or 0 when unknown.

cost.description: Pricing in USD per million tokens.

providers.description: Matching models grouped by provider. Your own provider comes first.

total.description: Number of matching models across all pages.

next.description: Offset of the next page, or null on the last page.
